title: ChatBos
tagline: ChatBos is an AI-driven personal assistant that helps blockchain professionals increase their efficiency and effectiveness by automating everyday tasks.
description:
ChatBos can help you stay organized, generate reports, and manage customer relationships. With ChatBos, you can access the latest insights and news about blockchain technology, find resources to further your knowledge, and collaborate with others in the blockchain industry.

And lot more, once it's ready...
how_its_made:
We use:
- *NEAR BOS* for folks that want a rich UI
- *XMTP* for machines and folks who don't want our UI
- AirStack for blockchain data enrichment
- LangChain running on node.js/Firebase because we still need some web2 tech to bring it all together

We wanted to also do a few more experiments, but these didn't work out, at all:
- WorldCoin to make sure we don't just have a bunch of AIs talking to each other
- Nouns inspiration for some awesome avatars
- Highlight, because 32x32px is sometimes not enough for ya PFP 
- Quicknode for blockchain data enrichment, in case AirStack didn't work out
